fact: The Ville de Niamey said on 5 January 2026 that its Naneye Yarda platform has recorded 35,000 taxpayers, each geolocated, with tax notices carrying a QR code and payment through money-transfer agencies or banks.
title: Journée portes ouvertes à l'Hôtel de Ville de Niamey : Faire découvrir l'institution et expliquer le fonctionnement du projet ''Naneye Yarda''
